input.memory_text: Likes Earl Grey tea because of its rich history, tradition, and bergamot aroma that evokes nostalgia

source_context.text: I like to drink Earl Grey tea, because the rich history and tradition behind Earl Grey tea. Its distinctive bergamot aroma provides a comforting sense of nostalgia. I dislike to drink energy drinks, because I find energy drinks too sweet and artificial. They lack the authenticity and historical roots that I value in my beverages. I dislike to drink bubble tea, because the texture of the tapioca pearls is unappealing to me, and the drink often feels overly commercialized.
